column1: # Harmonic amplitudes of a real concert flute, in dB under each note's
# own fundamental, measured over 0.34s windows in the steady middle of
# each note.  This is what `flute`'s partial_lo/partial_hi tables in
# synth.c are fitted to, and the two-register split is fitted to the
# trend across f0 -- see "The flute" in the top-level README.
# Eight of the nine notes came from a take that has since been
# overwritten, so this file is now the only record of them.  The
# surviving note is the 536Hz one, which is recordings/flute2.f32.
# level is the note's own RMS in the recording, for reference only:
# the harmonics are all relative to that note's fundamental.
